mercury.credit: NASA/Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory/Carnegie Institution of Washington
mercury.treatment: Monochrome global photographic mosaic, orthographic projection.
mercury.label: Monochrome mosaic
mercury.rights: NASA mission imagery; educational/public-information reuse explicitly permitted by MESSENGER image-use policy, with credit and no endorsement.

venus.treatment: Violet-filter photograph, spatially filtered and colourized blue by the mission to reveal clouds; not natural colour.
venus.label: Colourized violet-filter image
venus.rights: NASA/JPL mission image; no third-party copyright restriction in caption; reusable under JPL image-use policy.

earth.mission: Suomi NPP / VIIRS · Blue Marble, January 2012
earth.treatment: Blue Marble photographic montage: data from four satellite orbits projected onto a globe, not a single exposure.
earth.label: Blue Marble composite
earth.rights: NASA image; no third-party copyright restriction in caption; NASA educational/informational reuse permitted.

mars.treatment: Enhanced colour photographic mosaic. Red/violet data with a synthesized green channel; darker regions are stretched darker and less red than their natural appearance.
mars.label: Enhanced colour mosaic
mars.rights: NASA/JPL/USGS mission image; no third-party copyright restriction in caption; reusable under JPL image-use policy.

jupiter.treatment: True-colour photographic composite: four Cassini images mapped onto a globe by the mission, not a single exposure. Europa casts the small dark shadow.
jupiter.label: True-colour mapped composite
jupiter.rights: NASA/JPL Cassini imaging-team release; no separate third-party copyright restriction in caption; reusable under JPL image-use policy with the full mission credit. Not an ESA image.

saturn.treatment: Natural-colour photographic mosaic. Circular crop shows the globe and inner rings; surrounding drawn rings are schematic. The source brightened moons for visibility; those moons are outside this crop.
saturn.label: Natural-colour composite
saturn.rights: NASA/JPL Cassini imaging-team release; no separate third-party copyright restriction in caption; reusable under JPL image-use policy with the full mission credit. Not an ESA image.

uranus.treatment: Only the LEFT, true-colour panel is used. Blue/green/orange-filter composite; the false-colour right panel is excluded. Drawn rings are schematic.
uranus.label: True-colour panel
uranus.rights: NASA/JPL mission image; no third-party copyright restriction in caption; reusable under JPL image-use policy.

neptune.treatment: Enhanced colour (contrast-enhanced orange/green/violet-filter composite), not a natural-colour reference.
neptune.label: Enhanced colour composite
neptune.rights: NASA/JPL mission image; no third-party copyright restriction in caption; reusable under JPL image-use policy.
